result.brief: 提出结构化免疫亲和与响应图保留的深度人工免疫网络，实现无回放的视觉类增量表征记忆，并验证自适应潜空间重组与逐层尺度校准机制。
result.reason: Proposes gradient-free structured immune affinity for replay-free visual class-incremental representation memory; representation-learning contribution but no video/multimodal world model or generative latent evidence.
